prompts.text: A clean meeting table in light wood with a compact stack of printed documents and a single pen. A softly blurred conference chair adds business context in natural daylight.
A shared work surface in matte laminate with an open paper notebook and a ceramic cup, lit by soft daylight. A muted seating nook suggests a temporary workspace.

debug.input_assessment: The source includes useful mobile business, document, meeting, calls/content, shared-workspace, and beyond-office cues. Technical AI, security, processor, connectivity, and product-specific claims were not translated into visible scene requirements.
debug.count_explanation: Four numbered KSPs contain usable scene or activity cues, so up to four prompts were allowed. Two prompts were returned because the cues overlap around mobile professional work, meetings, and shared work settings, and the medium oblique view should stay local.
